definition.description: Converts between YAML and JSON formats. Supports basic YAML parsing including objects, arrays, strings, numbers, and booleans.

inputFields.helpText: 'toJson' converts YAML to JSON. 'toYaml' converts JSON to YAML.
For toJson: YAML text. For toYaml: JSON object/array.
Number of spaces for YAML indentation (toYaml mode).
